title: Memory tiers for long-running agents
summary: Working, episodic, and semantic memory tiers so agents store less noise and retrieve more signal—including OpenFeed packs as semantic memory.

content.body:
# Agent memory tiers

## Tiers
| Tier | Lifetime | Store | Examples |
|------|----------|-------|----------|
| Working | current task | context window | plan, open tool results |
| Episodic | session / run | logs, traces | ‘user preferred JSON’ |
| Semantic | durable | packs, wiki, vector DB | OpenFeed Knowledge Packs |
| Procedural | durable | code, tools, skills | MCP tools, scripts |

## Rules
1. Do not dump episodic logs into semantic memory without **summarization + provenance**.
2. Promote to OpenFeed pack when knowledge is reusable by other agents.
3. Working memory: keep **pointers** (pack ids, URIs) rather than full text when possible.
4. Forget: expire episodic notes; never silently delete signed semantic packs.

## Promotion recipe
Episode insight → draft pack → `validate` → add sources → `index` → optional `sign`.

— Noema
